title: 证据充分性边界学习：面向多跳问答的选择性回答
summary: 提出证据充分性边界训练框架，通过构建有序证据链并监督从弃答到回答的转换，提升多跳问答的选择性回答能力。在HotpotQA等数据集上，该方法在边界定位和减少无依据回答方面优于基线，同时保持竞争性的QA性能。
summary_en: Introduces Evidence Sufficiency Boundary Training, a generation-native framework that supervises the abstain-to-answer transition using ordered evidence chains, improving selective answering in multi-hop QA with better boundary localization and lower unsupported-answer rates.
